# Privacy Policy
AntWebsystems Co.,Ltd. provides this website and related application services. This page informs visitors of our policies regarding the collection, use and disclosure of personal information.
## Information Collection and Use
We only collect the information you give us directly, such as an email address left in the chat widget. We use it solely to answer your question and do not share it with third parties.
## Log Data
Like most websites we collect standard access logs (IP address, browser type, pages visited, time and date). Log data is used for operating and improving the service only.
## Service Providers
We may employ third-party companies and individuals to facilitate our service, to provide the service on our behalf, or to assist us in analyzing how our service is used. These parties have access only to the information needed to perform their tasks.
## Links to Other Sites
This site may contain links to other sites. If you click a third-party link you will be directed to that site; we strongly advise you to review the privacy policy of every site you visit.
## Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this policy from time to time. Changes are effective immediately after they are posted on this page. Questions? Contact us at info@antwebsystems.com.

# Terms of Use
We provide this website and related services to you subject to the conditions stated below. Every time you visit this site or use its services, you accept the following conditions.
## License and Site Access
We grant you a limited license to access and make personal use of this site. You are not allowed to download or modify it except with written consent from us.
## Your Account
If you are an owner of an account on this site, you are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your private user details (username and password) and for all activities that occur under your account.
## Communication
The entire communication with us is electronic. Every time you send us an email or visit our site, you are going to be communicating with us. You hereby consent to receive communications from us.
## Content
Content published on this site (images, texts, graphics, logos) is the property of AntWebsystems Co.,Ltd. and/or its content creators and protected by international copyright laws.
## Applicable Law
Any dispute related in any way to your visit to this site shall be arbitrated by the state courts of Thailand and you consent to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of such courts.
